node.title: Re: Request for Feedback: Perl Documentation Site
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: I prefer the design of perldoc.pl a little more over the perldoc.perl.org redesigned look. One thing I miss from both sites is the quick navigation menu on the left - unfortunately, my [https://github.com/OpusVL/perldoc.perl.org/issues/32|suggestion] to bring it back to perldoc.perl.org was rejected without explanation. If perldoc.pl had such a menu, then it would become my preferred documentation site. Update: Actually, perldoc.perl.org is only my "preferred" site because PerlMonks [doc://] links to that, and when my brain is on autopilot I still type perldoc.perl.org in the address bar. Plus I remember reading somewhere that .pl domains are blocked in some countries - so I would welcome perldoc.pl somewhere beneath the perl.org domain :-)
